title: fix(plugin-detail): the record page hides a field whose own visibleWhen is false
body:
Fixes #35314

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录详情页(默认页与自建页的详情块)不再显示「显示条件」对当前记录为假的字段,与编辑表单一致;条件写错时照旧显示该字段并在控制台告警一次,也与表单一致。
- 为什么改:默认记录页把只在特定状态才有意义的字段(如审批不需要时的「申请资格审批」)也画出来,读者看到空的或误导的字段,同一条记录的页面与表单说法不一。
- 风险与回滚:若判错,会把本应显示的字段藏起来(数据仍在、接口仍返回,只是不画);整体回滚一个提交即可,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` 中新增的 `fieldPredicateVisible` 与 `dropPredicateHidden` 两处;其次同目录 `__tests__/record-details.fieldVisibleWhen-35314.test.tsx` 的对照矩阵。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.fieldVisibleWhen-35314.test.tsx`,预期 19 项全绿,其中每一行都同时断言表单与详情页的结论。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`record:details` now honours a field's own object-level `visibleWhen` (`Field.visibleWhen`: "field is shown only when TRUE (else hidden)") on every field it draws. Before, it evaluated a field GROUP's `visibleWhen` (the `{ group }` reference) and no field's, so the synthesized default record page drew a field whose predicate is false for the record, label and value.

- **Where it was missing.** The section fold in `record:details` (`fields: dropHidden(normaliseList(filterList(s.fields)))`) and the flat-body fold (`filteredFields`) applied field security, the label ladder and the header dedupe, and never read the object's field `visibleWhen`; `DetailSection` draws whatever it is handed. The group derivation (`deriveFieldGroupDetailEntries` / `toField`) does not carry the field predicate either, so neither layer saw it.
- **The fix.** One new fold, `dropPredicateHidden`, applied last to both lists. It reads the predicate off the object's field declaration by name and judges it with `fieldPredicateVisible`, which calls `resolveFieldRuleState` from `@object-ui/core`: the call the form renderer makes for a field's `visibleWhen`. So the fault direction is the field rule's (`VISIBLE_WHEN_FAULTED`, ADR-0137 D3): a predicate that cannot be evaluated SHOWS the field and warns once. That is the opposite of the group gate (fail-closed), on purpose; each slot keeps the direction the form gives it.
- **Record context.** The same inputs the existing group gate passes: `sectionPredicateRecord` (every declared field seeded `null`, relations collapsed to their stored id) bound as `record` and `previous`, plus `usePredicateScope()`. The lazily assembled record is now shared by both gates (`predicateRecord()`), so a body with no predicate does no extra work.
- **Scope of the guard.** It applies to every body `record:details` draws, because the renderer cannot tell the default page's enumerated sections from an authored page's: app-shell's running default page sends the ungrouped bucket, and the whole body of an object with no `fieldGroups`, as enumerated sections of the same shape an authored page writes. One guard closes the class instead of a default-page-only branch.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.fieldVisibleWhen-35314.test.tsx` (19 tests):

- **Parity matrix (10).** Each case renders the same row through `record:details` (the synthesized default page) AND through the entry form renderer with the field carrying the same predicate, and asserts `{ form, detail }` against the expected verdict: envelope and bare-string spellings, no predicate, three fault shapes (unbound bare identifier, parse error, unknown field: drawn, fail-open), a declared-but-absent column (null seed), a relation bound as its id, `previous`, and the host `current_user` scope.
- **Every body (7).** Synthesized default page (grouped field, ungrouped bucket); running default page shape app-shell writes (grouped, ungrouped bucket, object with no `fieldGroups`); authored enumerated sections; authored flat `fields` list.
- **Controls (2).** A field whose predicate holds and a field with none are drawn; a section whose every member is hidden draws no heading (and draws it on the record where they show).

Harness guards: each render first finds an ungated anchor value and throws `HARNESS DEAD` otherwise, so an empty body cannot pass a hidden leg.

## Acceptance notes

- **Authored pages change too, deliberately.** On the base, an authored `record:details` section (or flat `fields` list) naming a field whose `visibleWhen` is false also drew it (measured red above). The guard closes that in the same fold, under the bounded in-place rule: same defect class, mechanical, same file, no new gate surface. Nothing changes for a field with no predicate, a field whose predicate holds, or a `{ group }` section's own gate.
- **Evaluated against the stored record, not the inline-edit draft**, like the group gate: editing `stage` inline reveals a gated field after save, not while typing.
- **Display only.** The record API still returns the field, as with a form-hidden field.
- **Not covered here:** `record:highlights` (the header strip) and the `detail-view` node / record drawer do not read a field's `visibleWhen` either. Not measured as reachable defects in this run; noted, not filed.
- **Real app.** `showcase_invoice.paid_on` (`visibleWhen: record.status == 'paid'`, object with no `fieldGroups`) is the in-repo fixture of this shape; its body is the "object with no fieldGroups" leg above. A live browser run was not made (no built console bundle in this container).
- The registry `inputs` text for `record:details` (and the generated reference page) says nothing false after this change, so it is not edited here.
